answer_1.quote: Our goal in this work is to create a text preview of the streamed content. We present StreamHover, a unsupervised model based on VQ-VAE to identify salient utterances from livestream transcripts to form preview summaries.

answer_2.quote: In Table 4: Results of extractive and abstractive summarizers evaluated by ROUGE.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to assess how StreamHover compares to strong extractive and abstractive baselines. Each evaluator is asked to select the best and worst of the summaries according to each of these criteria: Fluency/Coherence: is the summary well-presented, grammatically correct and easy to read? Informativeness: does the summary provide useful information about the video clip? Overall Quality: is the summary of good quality considering both content and linguistic aspects?
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators select best and worst summaries based on Fluency/Coherence, Informativeness, and Overall Quality.
